cards.answer: Garen is a fighter and tank who damages nearby enemies with sword spins. He uses a speed boost and a silencing attack to reach and pressure foes, then threatens weakened champions with a finishing blow.
cards.counterplay: Keep space from his spin and empowered attack. Retreat before losing enough health to become an easy finishing target.

cards.answer: Perseverance regenerates a portion of Garen's maximum health while active. Champion, epic monster or turret damage, enemy ability hits, and enemy summoner spells can temporarily interrupt it.
cards.counterplay: Use safe opportunities to pressure him so he cannot freely recover health between fights.

cards.answer: Decisive Strike grants movement speed and removes existing slows. Garen's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and silences its target.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance when he speeds toward you. Do not rely on an existing slow to stop his approach.

citations.quote: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him.

facts.claim: Decisive Strike grants movement speed and removes existing slows.

His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

facts.claim: Garen's next basic attack deals bonus physical damage and silences its target.

cards.priority_reason: The approach speed and silence create a consequential close-range threat.
uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.
Removing slows does not prevent their reapplication.
Spell shields negate only the silence; attack completion, lunge terrain interactions and on-hit details are advanced exceptions omitted from the beginner explanation.

cards.answer: Killing eligible enemies permanently builds Garen's armor and magic resistance, up to a cap. Activating Courage briefly grants a shield and increased tenacity. It also reduces incoming damage, with that protection lasting beyond the shield and tenacity.
cards.counterplay: Avoid committing your main burst and crowd control into his brief defensive opening.

cards.answer: Judgment repeatedly deals physical damage to nearby enemies as Garen spins, with increased damage to the nearest enemy hit. Bonus attack speed from items and level growth increases his number of spins. Repeated spin hits reduce enemy champions' armor.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his spin to limit repeated hits and armor reduction. Avoid being the nearest enemy hit when possible.

facts.claim: Bonus attack speed from items and level growth increases his number of spins.

uncertainties: UNAPPROVED draft.

Garen can move while spinning but cannot declare basic attacks; recasting can end the spin early.
The animation cap does not cap damage ticks. Not every source of bonus attack speed increases spin count.

cards.answer: Demacian Justice targets an enemy champion with a true-damage finishing blow. Its damage increases with the target's missing health.
cards.counterplay: Retreat before your health becomes critically low near Garen. A shield or spell shield can help protect against his finishing attempt.
